title: fix(plugin-sharing)!: a failed business-unit head or standalone manager read refuses instead of answering nobody
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8PbtXBL438ogqBSdDJ1FoMF)_

Fixes #29713

domain:server#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXRtwbd8e9gz1XdRgn

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: not needed. No skill and no `content/docs` page names `headOf` or the standalone `managerOf` fallback, or says what either answers on a failed read.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`BusinessUnitGraphService` 里还剩的两处查询 —— `headOf`（单元负责人）和未接 `TeamGraphService` 时的独立 `managerOf`（用户经理）—— 读表失败时不再答「没有负责人／没有经理」，而是明确报错；`headOf` 失败的结果也不再缓存一整轮。表或对象不存在仍答 `null`。
- 为什么改：#29606、#29655 已让同一服务的成员、种子、下级单元读在故障时报错；这两处仍把故障吞成 `null`，`headOf` 还把这个 `null` 缓存到本轮结束，读恢复后负责人仍是空的。今天还没有调用方，但第一个按「单元负责人／用户经理」授权或派审批的消费者会在故障期间悄悄漏掉这个人。
- 风险与回滚：仓内无生产调用方（共享规则、审批、所有权队列都不调这两个方法，已逐一追踪），故本版运行行为不变；唯一「从答 `null` 变成报错」的是导出类的外部调用方在读失败时，属收窄，标题带 `!`。接了 `TeamGraphService` 的 `managerOf` 原样转发，未改。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/business-unit-graph.ts`（`headOf`、`managerOf` 的独立分支）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing exec vitest run src/business-unit-head-manager-reads.test.ts`，预期 11/11 通过（两个方法各自：读失败报错、恢复后答真值、对象缺失答 null；接线分支对照不变）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`BusinessUnitGraphService` (`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/business-unit-graph.ts`): the two lookups #29655 left now read through `readMembershipToCompletion`, the walk `seedIsUsable` and `readChildUnits` already use. No new helper.

- **`headOf(businessUnitId)`.** A failed `sys_business_unit` read throws `[sharing] the head of business unit 'ID' could not be read: …`. It used to answer `null` and cache that `null` for the pass. A failed read now throws before any `set`, so the next call reads again. A unit that does not exist, sits in another organization, or names no head still answers `null` and is cached as before. A missing `sys_business_unit` (`isObjectAbsentError`) answers `null`.
- **`managerOf(userId, organizationId)`, standalone fallback (no `teamGraph`).** A failed `sys_user` read throws `[sharing] the manager of user 'ID' could not be read: …`. It used to answer `null`. This fallback caches nothing, before or after. A missing `sys_user` answers `null`. The organization screen (`managerIsProvablyOutsideOrg`) keeps its ruled fail-open posture (#10153) and is unchanged.
- **The wired limb is unchanged.** With a `teamGraph`, `managerOf` still returns `TeamGraphService.managerOf`'s answer as it stands.
- The module-level `SYSTEM_CTX` constant had no reader left and is removed. The walk reads under team-graph's own system context, as the other reads of this file already did.
- No `packages/spec` change, no `protocol.ts`, no new export.

### Measured first (real engine, before and after)

The same scratch probe ran on `main` (`87956dcc`) and on the fix. On each, one read failed, then the same instance was called again.

| Reading | `main` | this PR |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `headOf` on a failed read | `null` | throws `the head of business unit 'bu_sales' could not be read: SQLITE_IOERR…` |
| `headOf`, same instance, after the read recovers | `null` (the failed answer was cached) | `usr_head` |
| `headOf`, `sys_business_unit` not registered | `null` | `null` |
| standalone `managerOf` on a failed read | `null` | throws `the manager of user 'usr_alice' could not be read: SQLITE_IOERR…` |
| standalone `managerOf`, same instance, after recovery | `usr_bob` (nothing cached) | `usr_bob` |
| standalone `managerOf`, `sys_user` not registered | `null` | `null` |

The card said both lookups cache the failed answer. Only `headOf` does. The standalone `managerOf` fallback has no cache, so its fix is the refusal alone.

### Callers on `main` (traced)

| Caller | Calls | What it sees on a refusal |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Sharing rules (`SharingRuleService.expandRecipient`) | `expandUnitMembers` / `expandUsers` only | nothing changes: neither lookup is called |
| Ownership queues (`ownership-queue-service.ts`) | `expandUnitMembers` / `expandUsers` only | nothing changes |
| Approvals (`ApprovalService.resolveApproverSpec`) | its own `lookupManager` and `expandBusinessUnitUsers`; it does not construct `BusinessUnitGraphService` | nothing changes |
| `expandPrincipal` `manager` arm (`team-graph.ts`) | `TeamGraphService.managerOf`, not this class | nothing changes |
| `BusinessUnitGraphService.managerOf` wired limb | `TeamGraphService.managerOf` | unchanged (control pin) |

`headOf` and `BusinessUnitGraphService.managerOf` have no production caller in this repository, hotcrm or docs.objectos.ai. The only reach is the exported class (`@objectstack/plugin-sharing` index) and the `IBusinessUnitGraphService` contract. No caller fails a whole pass where it used to drop one person.

## Tests

New file `src/business-unit-head-manager-reads.test.ts` runs on a real engine: ObjectQL + SqlDriver over in-memory SQLite, with the shipped `SysOrganization`, `SysBusinessUnit`, `SysUser` and `SysMember`. 11 tests:

| Pin | `headOf` | standalone `managerOf` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| control: healthy read | the head; a unit without one answers `null` | the manager; a user without one answers `null` |
| ⛔ failed read refuses | throws, names the unit | throws, names the user |
| ⛔ not cached: after recovery | the same instance answers `usr_head` | the same instance answers `usr_bob` |
| absence: object never registered | `null` | `null` |
| absence: table never created | `null` | `null` |

CONTROL: with a `TeamGraphService` wired, `managerOf` answers exactly what `TeamGraphService.managerOf` answers, on a healthy and on a failed read.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing test` at `39b2f260`: 65 files / 1380 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing typecheck`: exit 0.
- Existing `headOf` / `managerOf` pins (`business-unit-graph.test.ts`, `sharing-rule.test.ts`, `manager-org-screen.test.ts`) pass unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- `TeamGraphService.managerOf` (`team-graph.ts`) also catches a failed `sys_user` read to `null` and caches it for the pass. It belongs to the same family, but the order keeps the wired limb unchanged, and its one in-repo consumer, `expandPrincipal`'s `manager` arm, is exported with no in-repo caller. Noted, not filed.
- Both refusals reuse `readMembershipToCompletion`'s sentence family. Its closing clause speaks of a holder set, which reads loosely for a single head or manager. Reusing the helper was the order. A wording change belongs to that helper, not here.
